description: Title, first author, year, publication types, retracted and library level for up to 200 PubMed IDs in one call. Faster and far smaller than asking PubMed: known papers come from disk, the rest in one request, stored for every later call; rows as arrays in columns order, ~120 characters a paper. Level "not found": PubMed has no such record. For abstract or full text: library_read.
name: library_pubmed_fetch_articles
